influences.name: New Kids on the Block
influences.context: Before us was the New Kids on the Block, and we were told by several people that there was a backlash that came about after them, that radio didn't want another group of a bunch of boys.

influences.name: Max Martin
influences.context: Max truly is the face of pop music, forever. And we are the first group that he did that with.

influences.name: Full Force
influences.context: Aside from working with Max, we started with a couple of these different urban writer and producers like Full Force, who wrote 'All I Have to Give.' Stuff like this [was special], working with these urban acts that entrusted this five-part white group harmony group that we could pull off urban records.

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: You would think it was, like, the Beatles, or Michael Jackson, fans going crazy.
